featured.name: local_ai_infrastructure
featured.title: LOCAL AI INFRASTRUCTURE
featured.description: Distributed AI workflow platform using Python, Ollama, Docker, Playwright and Open WebUI for autonomous orchestration and local LLM execution across multiple systems.
featured.problem: Teams need local LLM inference for privacy/cost but lack production-ready orchestration, multi-node scaling, and browser automation integration.
featured.solution: Multi-node Ollama cluster with load balancing, Playwright browser automation, Open WebUI plugin, and zero-config Docker/K8s deployment.
highlights: Multi-node inference with automatic load balancing
Browser automation integrated into LLM workflows
Open WebUI compatible — drop-in replacement for cloud APIs
Benchmarked: 10x cost reduction vs cloud APIs

featured.name: ai_workflow_automation
featured.title: AI WORKFLOW AUTOMATION
featured.description: Automation framework integrating local AI models with browser automation and custom workflows to handle repetitive engineering tasks and document processing.
featured.problem: Engineers waste hours on repetitive tasks (code review prep, doc generation, dependency updates) that require both reasoning and browser interaction.
featured.solution: Local LLM + Playwright agent framework with workflow DSL. Self-healing selectors, reasoning loops, and audit trails.
highlights: 95%+ success rate on benchmark automation tasks
YAML workflow DSL — no code for common patterns
Full audit trail with screenshots + reasoning logs

featured.name: ethed
featured.title: ETH.ED — AI-Powered Web3 Learning Platform
featured.description: AI-powered Web3 learning platform with gamified lessons, ENS-based certificates, and smart contract micropayments. Next.js + AI + Ethereum.
featured.problem: Web3 education is fragmented, theoretical, and lacks verifiable credentials. Learners can't prove on-chain knowledge.
featured.solution: Interactive lessons with AI tutors, ENS-subdomain certificates minted as NFTs, micropayments for premium content via smart contracts.
highlights: AI tutor with RAG over Ethereum documentation
Smart contract micropayments for content creators

featured.name: eipsinsight
featured.title: EIPSINSIGHT — Ethereum Governance Analytics
featured.description: Ethereum governance analytics platform for tracking EIP lifecycles, governance signals, and stakeholder influence. Real-time dashboard with on-chain + off-chain data fusion.
featured.problem: Ethereum governance is opaque. Stakeholders can't track EIP progress, gauge sentiment, or understand influence networks.
featured.solution: Unified dashboard ingesting GitHub, Discord, on-chain voting, and forum data. Stakeholder graphs, predictive models, and real-time alerts.

featured.name: facial_keygen
featured.title: FACIAL KEYGEN — Biometric Cryptographic Key Derivation
featured.description: Python-based biometric authentication system generating cryptographic keys from facial biometrics using computer vision and ML for post-quantum security research.
featured.problem: Traditional key management is vulnerable to phishing, loss, and quantum attacks. Biometrics offer usable but cryptographically sound alternatives.
featured.solution: Fuzzy extractor pipeline: face embedding → error correction → uniform key derivation. Reproducible keys from noisy biometric input.

featured.name: airgesture
featured.title: AIRGESTURE — Touchless Presentation Control
featured.description: Real-time computer vision app using OpenCV and MediaPipe that translates hand gestures into presentation controls for touchless classroom interaction.
featured.problem: Presenters are tethered to keyboards/clickers. Touchless control needed for hygiene, accessibility, and mobility.
featured.solution: MediaPipe hand tracking + gesture classification → keyboard/mouse emulation. Runs locally, <50ms latency, works on any webcam.
highlights: Zero external dependencies — runs fully offline

featured.name: etherworld_ios
featured.title: ETHERWORLD IOS — Scalable iOS App Architecture
featured.description: Designed the application architecture and modular structure for the EtherWorld iOS app — scalable navigation, API integration, and maintainable app structure.
featured.problem: iOS apps often become unmaintainable spaghetti. Need clean architecture from day one for Web3 integrations.
featured.solution: Modular MVVM + Coordinator pattern. Protocol-oriented networking. Web3.swift integration. Feature-flags for gradual rollout.
highlights: Type-safe API layer with code generation
Web3 transaction signing flow with Secure Enclave

featured.name: smart_home_iot
featured.title: SMART HOME IOT — ESP32 Room Automation
featured.description: ESP32-based smart automation system for room automation with modular architecture, wireless control, sensor monitoring, and intelligent device management.
featured.problem: Consumer IoT is fragmented, cloud-dependent, and insecure. Need local-first, modular, privacy-respecting alternative.
featured.solution: ESP32 mesh network with MQTT, Home Assistant integration, OTA updates, and local automation rules. No cloud required.

featured.name: this_portfolio
featured.title: THIS PORTFOLIO — Immersive 3D Developer Portfolio
featured.description: Immersive developer portfolio with a 3D dome gallery, scroll-driven animations, and an editorial bronze design system. Next.js + Three.js + custom design tokens.
featured.problem: Portfolios are generic. Need to demonstrate engineering craft through the portfolio itself.
featured.solution: Custom 3D engine with dome projection, scroll-linked animations, token-driven design system, and progressive enhancement for mobile.
highlights: Custom 3D dome gallery with 60fps mobile target
